scripts.pack:dev: pnpm bump-version prerelease && pnpm build:force && pnpm build && pnpm clean:tgz && pnpm pack && pnpm dlx shx@0.4.0 ls "$PWD/*.tgz"

releases.name: v5.3.0
releases.body:
## What's Changed
* Update @freelensapp packages to ^1.9.0 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/freelensapp/freelens-fluxcd-extension/pull/228
* Fix typo in tooltip label for pie chart by @dex4er in https://github.com/freelensapp/freelens-fluxcd-extension/pull/229
* Use React components from Freelens v1.6.2 by @dex4er in https://github.com/freelensapp/freelens-fluxcd-extension/pull/230
* Fix the view for Kube Config for the newer Flux APIs by @jkroepke in https://github.com/freelensapp/freelens-fluxcd-extension/pull/204

## New Contributors
* @jkroepke made their first contribution in https://github.com/freelensapp/freelens-fluxcd-extension/pull/204

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/freelensapp/freelens-fluxcd-extension/compare/v5.2.2...v5.3.0

releases.name: v3.1.0
releases.body:
## What's Changed
* More detailed HelmRelease view by @dex4er in https://github.com/freelensapp/freelens-extension-fluxcd/pull/18
* More optional chaining operators to prevent crashing by @dex4er in https://github.com/freelensapp/freelens-extension-fluxcd/pull/23
* Update dependency @types/react to ^17.0.86 by @renovate in https://github.com/freelensapp/freelens-extension-fluxcd/pull/20
* Update dependency sass to ^1.89.0 by @renovate in https://github.com/freelensapp/freelens-extension-fluxcd/pull/13
* Update dependency @types/node to ^22.15.21 by @renovate in https://github.com/freelensapp/freelens-extension-fluxcd/pull/14

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/freelensapp/freelens-extension-fluxcd/compare/v3.0.0...v3.1.0
